spatialRealityDna.commercialScale: 100-180 sqm TCM clinic + 调养空间, 5-8 个 consultation 床位 + 2-3 个 treatment_room
spatialRealityDna.operationLogic: consultation + tea + slow treatment 节奏; staff 中医师 1-3 人 + 助手 2-3 人 + 茶艺师 1 人, 客户单次 60-90 分钟, 复诊率高
spatialRealityDna.userFlow: street -> reception -> waiting -> consultation (中医师把脉问诊) -> tea_corner (调理方案讨论) -> treatment_room (针灸/推拿) -> checkout, 路径慢节奏可停顿
spatialRealityDna.privacyRequirement: layered privacy: open reception, semi-open tea_corner, enclosed consultation, enclosed treatment; consultation 不可见听, treatment 完全封闭
spatialRealityDna.materialReality: natural wood (榆木/胡桃木), 宣纸或亚麻 fabric 软隔, herbal cabinet 实木, 茶具真实陶瓷, 不可出现 大理石 / 玻璃幕墙 / 亚克力 / 镜面金属 / LED 灯带
